usage.goal: Name common colors and use them to describe simple objects.
usage.canDoStatement: I can say basic colors around me.

scenes.scenario: I see a red apple, a blue bag, and a yellow bus.
scenes.imageBrief: Three everyday objects clearly showing red apple, blue bag, and yellow bus.

scenes.scenario: The green leaf is small, the orange ball is round, and the purple kite is in the sky.
scenes.imageBrief: Outdoor scene with a green leaf, orange ball, and purple kite.

scenes.scenario: My pink toy is new, the brown table is big, and the black cat is sleeping.
scenes.imageBrief: Cozy home scene showing a pink toy, brown table, and black cat.

scenes.scenario: The white cloud is high, the cyan shirt is clean, and the magenta flower is bright.
scenes.imageBrief: Scene or display showing a white cloud, cyan shirt, and magenta flower with very clear colors.

scenes.scenario: I have a lime pencil, a teal cup, and an indigo notebook.
scenes.imageBrief: Desk scene with a lime pencil, teal cup, and indigo notebook.

reading.title: Color Day
reading.text: Today is Color Day at school. I bring a blue bag and a yellow pencil. My friend has a pink toy and a brown box. We draw a red apple, a green leaf, and a purple kite. Our class looks bright and happy.
reading.imageBrief: Happy classroom art scene featuring several clearly colored objects mentioned in the story.

video.title: Find the Color
video.idea: 30–45 second video. A presenter looks around the room and names colored objects, then asks the viewer to find the next color.
video.scriptStarter: Can you find something red? I see a red apple. Now find something blue.

usage.goal: Describe color qualities such as light, dark, bright, warm, cool, and neutral.
usage.canDoStatement: I can talk about simple color types and how colors feel.

scenes.scenario: The violet scarf is soft, the coral wall is pretty, and the salmon fish picture is bright.
scenes.imageBrief: Three easy objects or surfaces showing violet, coral, and salmon clearly.

scenes.scenario: The turquoise cup is on the table, the lavender pillow is on the chair, and the light blue sky is clear.
scenes.imageBrief: Calm home scene with a turquoise cup, lavender pillow, and a light blue sky seen through a window.

scenes.scenario: This shirt is dark, that star is bright, and the old poster looks dull.
scenes.imageBrief: Three-panel comparison showing dark shirt, bright star, and dull poster.

scenes.scenario: The vivid flower stands out, the pale pink wall is soft, and the deep green bottle is beautiful.
scenes.imageBrief: Simple comparison scene with vivid flower, pale wall, and deep green bottle.

scenes.scenario: Red and orange feel warm, blue feels cool, and gray looks neutral.
scenes.imageBrief: Friendly infographic showing warm colors, cool colors, and neutral gray.

reading.title: In the Art Room
reading.text: In the art room, we talk about colors. Our teacher shows a bright poster and a dull poster. Then she shows warm colors like red and orange and cool colors like blue. I like the pale pink wall and the deep green paint.
reading.imageBrief: Art room with posters, paint swatches, and warm/cool color examples.

video.title: Warm, Cool, Bright
video.idea: 35–45 second video. The teacher or guide shows paint cards and uses simple contrast pairs: bright vs dull, warm vs cool, pale vs deep.
video.scriptStarter: This poster is bright. This one is dull. Red feels warm. Blue feels cool.

usage.goal: Understand simple art words related to mixing and color change.
usage.canDoStatement: I can talk about mixing colors in a simple way.

scenes.scenario: I mix blue and yellow, I blend the paint, and I make a darker shade.

check.question: What do I do after I mix the paint?

scenes.imageBrief: Art desk scene showing paint being mixed and blended to create a darker shade.

scenes.scenario: White makes a light tint, blue is a cool hue, and strong color has high saturation.
scenes.imageBrief: Clean color-learning card explaining tint, hue, and saturation with swatches.

scenes.scenario: The sky picture has a blue gradient, and the rainbow has many colors.
scenes.imageBrief: Simple scene with a sky gradient and a rainbow.

scenes.scenario: The spectrum shows many colors, and pigment gives paint its color.
scenes.imageBrief: Friendly visual card showing a color spectrum and pigment in paint.

reading.title: Painting Time
reading.text: It is painting time. I mix red and yellow to make orange. My friend blends blue and white to make a light tint. Our teacher shows a rainbow and says the spectrum has many colors. The pigment in the paint makes the colors strong.
reading.imageBrief: Art class painting scene with mixing paints, a rainbow poster, and paint trays.

video.idea: 35–50 second video. A child mixes paint, the camera shows the color change, and the narrator names mix, blend, tint, gradient, and rainbow.
video.scriptStarter: Watch me mix red and yellow. Now I blend the paint. White makes a light tint.
